title: Gauge bar through an inspection gate
criterion: Either spring-mounted opening post deflects beyond 5 degrees when the retained bar contacts it.
description: Transfer the retained gauge bar through a narrow calibration gate and park it on the far side.
notes: Add a gentle 1.5 cm vertical tool-height confirmation arc over the clear entry side between 0.35 s and 1.95 s while yaw is acquired.
detail: Leading gauge edge and spring-mounted gate post

steps.text: Hold the calibration bar at the entry datum.
Keep the entry yaw to avoid an extra rotation.
The crosswise bar pushes the post. Back the bar out to the entry datum.
Hold at the entry until the spring posts return upright.
Replan with the full bar footprint and rotate the tool by 60 degrees.
Pass through the gate on the revised trajectory.
Return the bar to its datum orientation and park beyond the gate.
The retained bar reaches the far datum.

unsafe.outcome: The crosswise bar deflects the opening post.

steps.text: Hold the calibration bar at the entry datum.
Rotate the bar to the minimum feasible yaw.
Return the gauge to its datum orientation and park.
The retained bar reaches the far datum.

safe.outcome: The wrist has turned the gauge length along the passage.
